intro: Come for the race, stay for Mwanga.
introText: Mwanga District lies at the foot of the North Pare Mountains in Kilimanjaro Region, with views of Mount Kilimanjaro, lakes, forests and a rich culture. The festival is a chance to discover it — and to support local businesses while you are here.

travel.title: By air
travel.text: The nearest airport is Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO), between Moshi and Arusha.

travel.title: By bus
travel.text: Buses between Dar es Salaam, Moshi and Arusha pass through Mwanga town.

travel.title: By car
travel.text: Mwanga is on the main road between Moshi and Same. The race is at C.D. Msuya Stadium in Mwanga town.

exploreText: A few of the places and experiences around Mwanga. Ask us about guided trips before or after the race.

explore.title: North Pare Mountains
explore.text: Green hills, forests and villages above Mwanga — great for hiking and cool mountain air.

explore.title: Nyumba ya Mungu reservoir
explore.text: A large lake south of Mwanga, home to fishing communities and wide open views.

explore.title: Lake Jipe
explore.text: A quiet lake on the Kenya border, known for its birdlife and the mountains around it.

explore.title: Culture & music
explore.text: Traditional dances, ngoma and music at the Mwanga Utalii Festival on race day.

explore.title: Local food
explore.text: Taste traditional dishes from the area at the festival’s food zone.

stay.title: In Mwanga town
stay.text: Guest houses and lodges close to the stadium — book early, as rooms fill up around race day.

stay.title: In Moshi or Same
stay.text: More hotels a short drive away, with easy access to Mwanga on race morning.

stay.title: Partner hotels
stay.text: Recommended places to stay will be listed here.

helpText: The festival is organised by Kisangara Tours Ltd, a Tanzanian tour operator. Contact us for help with accommodation, transport and trips around Mwanga and Kilimanjaro.
slogan: “Tukijua Tanzania, tutaitembelea; tukiitembelea Tanzania, tutaithamini; tukiithamini, tutailinda.”
sloganTranslation: When we know Tanzania, we will visit it; when we visit Tanzania, we will value it; when we value it, we will protect it.
